caption: The drawing depicts a toy elephant made of what appears to be painted metal, standing on a green rectangular platform with four red wheels attached at each corner. The elephant is colored brown with patches of wear revealing areas of white beneath the paint. There is a decorative blanket or covering draped over its back with a yellow border and a dark central section. On top of the elephant sits a small figure painted in red and white. The background is plain and off-white, providing no additional context or objects, and the entire composition is centered on the page.
title: Toy Elephant
